# maven-hosted (maven hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## Maven credentials — settings.xml
<servers>
  <server>
    <id>maven-hosted</id>
    <username>ci</username>
    <password>${env.ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}</password>
  </server>
</servers>

## Maven repository — pom.xml
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>maven-hosted</id>
    <url>http://gateway.test/gw/maven/maven-hosted/</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>

## Maven deployment — pom.xml
<distributionManagement>
  <repository>
    <id>maven-hosted</id>
    <url>http://gateway.test/gw/maven/maven-hosted/</url>
  </repository>
</distributionManagement>
